_comment: Authorized transcript reviewers. The `reviewer` field on every transcript must be
one of the `github` values below — the review UI offers only these as choices, and
scripts/review_status.py --check fails the build on anything else.
To add someone: append an entry and open a PR. Use their GitHub username as `github`
so a review attributes to the same identity that authors the PR. Keep the list sorted
